claims.claim: Default command entry consumes both model-endpoint observations and invokes C.
claims.support: Default initializer tests, 9084 persisted HTTP events and fresh captured-observation C replay agree.
claims.qualification: Software integration with loopback fixed-plan fixtures and recorded operator overrides, not real-model accuracy or physical deployment.

claims.claim: Observed network/resource failures change route with reasons.
claims.support: 14-phase synthetic replay, 333 checked switches, exact C rerun and HTTP event observations.
claims.qualification: Injected application-level faults/telemetry; no captured household/radio causal generalization.

claims.claim: Rule and model command paths retain the structured whitelist.
claims.support: Shared full-batch allowlisted executor, state lock, 25 rejection/unchanged-state cases, three positive controls and local/default-entry tests.
claims.qualification: Structured action boundary on isolated simulated state, not complete natural-language authorization, prompt-injection or physical-safety certification.

claims.claim: Joint information affects contract attainment under declared loads.
claims.support: Seven matched replay arms and separate real-thread/HTTP queue workloads show both benefits and regressions.
claims.qualification: No uniform superiority. Completion and deadline attainment remain separate. Deterministic replay alone is paired; HTTP health differs across arms.
